fluff.overview: Opponents of the Third Lyran Guards should hope they catch the Heavy Urban Response Platoon of the 608th Lyran MTR in the open and on the defensive. Equipped with auto-rifles and man-portable plasma rifles, this motorized platoon of twenty-eight troopers can dig into an urban structure and hold it with a tenacity that belies their conventional infantry classification. The plasma rifles generate enough thermal output to threaten heat-sensitive BattleMechs while punishing any infantry caught without cover. Dislodging the platoon from a fortified building may require a full company-level commitment. On the offensive they remain dangerous, capable of concentrating enough firepower to bring down a light 'Mech in a single coordinated salvo.
